review_candidates.description: Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth. At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business. About The Role As a Senior Auditor – IT & Technology Audit (Cyber) within Global Internal Audit , you will support the Engagement Manager in planning, executing, and reporting IT and Cybersecurity audit engagements across audit, SOX, and advisory workstreams. You will work in a dynamic global environment, gaining diverse experiences across process and technology domains, leading cyber risk assessments, supervising junior team members, and engaging with functional heads and senior leaders. As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact while enjoying unmatched learning and certification opportunities. In This Role, You Will Understand engagement objectives and assist the Engagement Manager in preparing the audit plan and testing procedures to meet review objectives. Gain a detailed understanding of relevant IT and business processes, systems, and controls; lead cyber risk assessments and controls evaluations, and identify opportunities to leverage data analytics. Perform engagements in accordance with planned scope and risk areas, aligned with budget expectations; supervise executives and junior team members, driving their accountability, timely execution, and knowledge sharing within the team. Ensure work paper documentation thoroughly supports and validates audit activities and findings; adhere to Corporate Audit Methodology and documentation requirements at all times. Assist in the assessment of identified gaps and areas for improvement, evaluate their significance and potential business impact, and propose practical and reasonable remediation steps; prepare audit reports and memos highlighting key risk exposures, noted issues, overall conclusions, and agreed-upon corrective actions. Drive discussions and agreements on detailed audit findings with the audit team and management prior to final report issuance; follow up with process owners for timely implementation of MAPs, escalating where required. Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders; ensure timely and accurate time tracking, and drive continuous self-development through relevant training, seminars, and professional certifications. Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work. What You Must Have To Be Considered Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering or another technical domain, with at least 4 years of experience in IT and Cybersecurity audit – ideally a mix of time in a Big 4 public accounting firm and a large international audit and control function. Good understanding of the IIA International Professional Practices Framework, Internal Audit and Risk Management methodologies (e.g. COSO), and frameworks such as COBIT, ISO, and NIST; experience with risk-based auditing and Sarbanes-Oxley testing, preferably within the technology industry. Strong analytical skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple concurrent projects and meet deadlines while working both independently and in a team environment. Good verbal and written communication and presentation skills; demonstrated thirst for knowledge and new experiences; highest professional standards, integrity, and ethical behavior. A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges. The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It These will help you succeed CISA, CISSP, or CISM certification is preferred; experience with or certification in IT audit tools is an advantage. Experience working within the technology industry and exposure to cyber audit engagements across a globally dispersed environment. Work model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring work a minimum of 3 days a week at Cognizant office in MEPZ, Tambaram, Chennai combined with remote work. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

review_candidates.title: Information Security Analyst
review_candidates.description: Work for Indiana Begin a fulfilling career with the State of Indiana by joining one of the largest employers in the state, offering a range of opportunities across 60+ agencies. At the state, you'll find competitive compensation, a robust benefits package and a commitment to work-life balance. Most importantly, you'll have the chance to make a real and measurable impact on the lives of Hoosiers across Indiana. About The Family & Social Services Administration (FSSA) FSSA was established by the Indiana General Assembly in 1991 to consolidate and better integrate the delivery of human services by state government. FSSA is a health care and social services funding agency. Ninety-four percent of the agency’s total budget is paid to thousands of service providers ranging from major medical centers to a physical therapist working with a child or adult with a developmental disability. The seven care divisions in FSSA administer services to more than 1.5 million Hoosiers. FSSA’s mission is to compassionately serve Hoosiers of all ages and connect them with social services, health care and their communities. Role Overview The role serves in the Division of Strategies & Technology. In this role, you will perform a variety of duties within the FSSA Privacy and Security Office as directed in relation to protecting and safeguarding FSSA client data such as developing and maintaining information security standards and working effectively with a wide range of information technologists, including systems administrators, technical support, applications development, end users and management. Your duties must be executed in a manner which is compliant with State of Indiana IOT and FSSA information security policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will thorough knowledge of information security management controls identified in the NIST 800-53 standards and of vulnerability management processes, including; discovery, assessment, prioritization, and remediation. They will have a familiarity with vulnerability management tools such as Rapid7 Insight VM and CrowdsStrike, and with domain structures, user authentication, and digital signatures. This candidate will have the ability to understand and apply complex computer logic to work. Salary The salary for this position traditionally starts at $61,022.00 but may be commensurate with education and work experience. Use our Compensation Calculator to view the total compensation package. A Day In The Life The essential functions of this role are as follows: Assists in developing plans to safeguard computer files against accidental or unauthorized modification, destruction, or disclosure and to meet emergency data processing needs. Monitors current reports of computer viruses to determine when to update virus protection systems. Assists with data transmissions and helps build firewalls to conceal confidential information as it is being transmitted and to keep out corrupt digital transfers. Performs risk assessments and executes tests of data processing systems to ensure functioning of data processing activities and security measures. Assists with modifying computer security files to incorporate new software, correct errors, or change individual access status. Supports violations of computer security procedures and discusses procedures with violators to ensure violations are not repeated. Documents computer security and emergency measures policies, procedures, and tests. Consults with users to discuss issues such as computer data access needs, security violations, and programming changes. Monitors use of data files and regulate access to safeguard information in computer files. Coordinates implementation of computer system plan with establishment personnel and outside vendors. Trains users and promotes security awareness to ensure system security and to improve server and network efficiency. The job profile is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. This position is exempt from overtime compensation for additional work hours which may be required to complete essential functions or other assigned work. Exempt employees may work more than 75 hours in a pay period without additional compensation and must report a minimum of 75 hours per pay period of work hours and/or paid leave taken to receive their base biweekly salary. What You'll Need For Success Individuals in this role should minimally be able to articulate or demonstrate the following: Strong knowledge of a broad array of security software applications and tools. Strong understanding of computer-related security systems including firewalls and encryption. Strong knowledge of state and federal legislation and regulatory laws pertaining to information system security and privacy. Strong technical writing and research skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and manage changing priorities. Ability to understand and apply complex computer logic to duties being performed. Ability to identify and mitigate network vulnerabilities. Ability to work autonomously and handle multiple assignments. A degree is not required. However, at least 5+ years of experience applying the outlined knowledge, skills, and abilities in a similar role may be considered. Individuals should have the ability to perform essential functions with or without reasonable accommodation. Supervisory Responsibilities/Direct Reports This role may be utilized in a supervisory capacity based on agency needs. Benefits Of Employment With The State Of Indiana The State of Indiana offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees which includes: Three (3) medical plan options (including RX coverage) as well as vision and dental plans Wellness Rewards Program: Complete wellness activities to earn gift card rewards Health savings account, which includes bi-weekly state contribution Deferred compensation 457(b) account (similar to 401(k) plan) with employer match Two (2) fully-funded pension plan options A robust, comprehensive program of leave policies covering a variety of employee needs, including but not limited to: 150 hours of paid New Parent Leave and up to eight weeks of paid Childbirth Recovery Leave for eligible mothers Up to 15 hours of paid community service leave Combined 180 hours of paid vacation, personal, and sick leave time off 12 paid holidays, 14 on election years Education Reimbursement Program Group life insurance Referral Bonus program Employee assistance program that allows for covered behavioral health visits Qualified employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program Free Parking for most positions Free LinkedIn Learning access Equal Employment Opportunity The State of Indiana is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to recruiting, selecting, developing, and promoting employees based on individual ability and job performance. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities to complete the application and interview process as well as perform the essential functions of a role. If you require reasonable accommodations to complete this application, you can request assistance by contacting the Indiana State Personnel Department at jobs@spd.IN.gov .

We are committed to delivering high-quality products and solutions while providing an exceptional customer experience. At AIM Group, we value professionalism, innovation, teamwork, and continuous development, creating a dynamic work environment where employees can grow their skills and build successful careers. Role Description The Sales Engineer role at AIM GROUP is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo. The Sales Engineer will work closely with the sales team and customers to understand technical requirements, present product capabilities, and propose tailored solutions that address client needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing and delivering technical presentations, responding to customer inquiries, providing pre-sales and post-sales technical support, and coordinating with internal technical teams to ensure smooth project execution. The role involves gathering customer feedback, assisting in solution design, and supporting the sales process with accurate technical documentation and proposals. The Sales Engineer will also participate in meetings, site visits, and demonstrations, maintaining clear communication with clients and internal stakeholders. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to analyze requirements, design solutions, and assist with implementation. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to build trust, manage expectations, and provide clear technical explanations to diverse audiences. Candidates should possess solid Sales skills to support opportunity development, contribute to proposals, and help close deals in alignment with business goals. Candidates should ideally have a background in engineering or a related technical field, with the ability to understand complex systems and technologies. Candidates should demonstrate problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Candidates should be comfortable working on-site in Cairo, with readiness to visit customer locations as needed. Relevant experience in a similar role and familiarity with the industry or products offered by AIM GROUP are beneficial.

review_candidates.description: Title: Software Engineer Location: Galway (Hybrid) About Ministry Brands Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for purpose-driven organisations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades. Our Galway R&D centre is Ministry Brands' global AI R&D hub and is in the middle of a major expansion as we deliver a multi-year AI-native transformation of our product portfolio. About The Role We're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You'll work on scalable, cloud-based applications that power our products and help deliver exceptional experiences to our customers. Working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team, you'll design, build, and maintain high-quality software while contributing to the ongoing evolution of our platform. We move fast, hold high standards, and care deeply about building things well. If you're passionate about developing great software and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, we'd love to hear from you. What You Will Do Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using .NET and C#. Build and maintain scalable APIs and backend services. Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality software. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimise application performance. Contribute to technical discussions and continuous improvement initiatives. Support the delivery of new features and enhancements across our products. What You Bring Experience developing applications using C# and the .NET framework (.NET Core/.NET 6+ preferred). Experience building RESTful APIs. Experience working with SQL Server or other relational databases. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure (preferred) or AWS. Experience with Git and modern software development practices. Experience with React and React Native is preferred. Experience with SignalR, Redis, Event Bus, and Kafka is preferred. Familiarity with frontend technologies such as Angular or similar is an advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team. What's In It For You At Ministry Brands, we invest in our people and provide the support, flexibility, and opportunities you need to do your best work and grow your career. Hybrid working model based from our Galway office. 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. 100% employer-paid private health insurance, including cover for dependents. Dental coverage. Employer-matched pension scheme. Income protection and life assurance. Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing initiatives. Career development through mentorship, professional training, and certification opportunities. Galway gym membership. Annual volunteer day. Amazing company culture.
